morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分；英式读音中的 r 不发音。尚无资料支持建立马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 雄鹿；尤指成年雄性马鹿，传统用法常特指五岁以上者。属于英语旧用语。
senses.en_definition: An old or literary English term for a male deer, especially a mature male red deer.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris lama bagi rusa jantan, khususnya rusa merah jantan yang matang.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项，马来语解释为编写释义，并非 DBP 原文。马来语一般使用 rusa jantan；不能把所有 rusa 都译成 hart。下列组合用于马来语中的词语讨论，未经语料频率验证。[英语释义与发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hart)。

messages.ms_spoken: Ya, rusa jantan. Tapi tu perkataan Inggeris lama; dalam bahasa Melayu, sebut rusa jantan je.

messages.en: Yes, a male deer. It's an old English word; in Malay, just say rusa jantan.

etymology.historical_story: English hart descends through Middle English from Old English heorot or heort. Its Germanic relatives connect the animal with horns, making antlers a useful historical image. The word survives particularly in older writing and traditional descriptions of deer. This history belongs to English and does not establish hart as a Malay borrowing. [Etymology](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/hart).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hart 与英式英语 heart 同音：想象一只胸前画着爱心的雄鹿。只是记忆联想，不是词源关系。
